name: Revitalizing Ritual
description:
**Subclass Feature**

Each time you finish a respite, you can choose yourself or one ally who is also finishing a respite to gain the benefit of a divine ritual. The chosen character gains a +1 bonus to their recovery value that lasts until you finish another respite.
